entities.summary: Japanese art genre, fl. 17th–19th c., consisting of woodblock prints and paintings of such subjects as female beauties, kabuki actors, sumo wrestlers, scenes from history and folk tales, travel scenes, landscapes, flora, fauna, and erotica Originating c. 1700 CE. ukiyo-e is a art movement with roots in Asia, arising around 1700. A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
